title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Bujjigadu
desc: Bujji moves to Chennai after an argument with his childhood friend Chitti. He returns after 12 years to prove his love for her.

title: Gumnaam
desc: An astute sub-inspector relentlessly pursues a malicious serial killer who victimises vulnerable adolescent girls. Therefore, this probe incurs severe consequences.

title: Bengal Tiger
desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

title: Bhairavakona
desc: After committing a robbery, Basava and his companion, John, run into Agraharam Geetha, a stranger, and the trio end up in Bhairavakona, a village shrouded in mystery.

title: Aho Vikramaarka
desc: A ruthless cop unearths a sinister mystery, compelling him to confront the villainous Asura and rescue the victims held captive in his clutches.
